subject: Logic
title: Quantifier Negation
description: A fast breakdown of Quantifier Negation for builders.

hook.text: Negating "everyone is happy" doesn't give "nobody is happy." It gives "someone isn't happy."

buildup.text: ¬∀x P(x) ≡ ∃x ¬P(x). Negating "for all" flips to "there exists one that doesn't."

discovery.text: ¬∃x P(x) ≡ ∀x ¬P(x). Negating "there exists" flips to "none do."

twist.text: These are the De Morgan's laws for quantifiers. Same pattern: negate, flip the quantifier, negate inside.

climax.text: Getting quantifier negation right prevents the most common logical errors in philosophy and law.
